Privacy Policy

This notice explains what information Abu Dhabi Properties collects when you visit, and why. Last updated: 2026-11-14.

Who is responsible

The website is operated by Abu Dhabi Properties (the "controller"). Contact: editor@abudhabi-properties.com.

What we collect

We do not ask you to create an account and we do not collect enquiries from property buyers. With your consent, we use Google Analytics 4 via Google Tag Manager (once configured) to measure aggregated usage: pages viewed, approximate location (country/city), device and browser type, how you arrived (for example a search engine, social network or advertising campaign including UTM parameters), and which links to developers' official websites were clicked.

If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you choose to include, and use it only to reply.

Cookies and consent

Analytics and advertising cookies are off by default. They are only set if you choose "Accept" in the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time using Cookie settings. We use Google Consent Mode so that Google services respect your choice.

Purposes and legal basis

Analytics data is used to understand how the guide is used, improve content, and report aggregated interest in each featured company. Processing is based on your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.

Sharing and international transfers

Analytics data is processed by Google LLC and its affiliates as our service provider, which may involve transfers outside the United Arab Emirates. We may share aggregated, non-identifying statistics (for example, number of clicks to a company's website) with featured companies. We do not sell personal data.

Retention

Google Analytics event data is retained for 14 months, after which it is deleted automatically.

Your rights

This notice is provided in accordance with the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (PDPL), to the extent applicable, and other relevant UAE laws. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data we hold about you, and you may withdraw consent at any time, by writing to the address below. You may also contact the UAE Data Office or the competent authority.

Changes

We may update this notice; the date above shows the latest revision.
